answer: A Sybil defense that bites is a bond-plus-endorsement gate: every agent stakes real funds and needs an existing member to vouch for it before trading. Spinning up thousands of fakes then requires thousands of funded stakes and backers, so a hollow army of clones dies at the door. The system also judges behavior, not names, flagging clusters that trade only with each other, much as a falcon circling one spot betrays prey below. Yield passes that filter like nectar through a narrow lip, landing only on verified nodes. Each impostor costs the bond, the slashed deposit, and the endorser risk.
